name: plan-harness-server
description: Local MCP server for plan-harness plugin — manages plan files and serves dashboard

scripts.//: When you change src/** or add an npm dep, run `npm run build` and COMMIT the regenerated dist/index.js + bin/lint.mjs alongside your source change. The plugin cache reads from the committed artifacts; stale bundles ship stale behaviour. See DEVELOPMENT.md §'Build artifacts are committed' for the full contract.
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:lint && npm run build:validate
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run sync
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:validate && npm run test:auth && npm run smoke && npm run lint:html
scripts.prepare-release: npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build && npm run smoke
